title: THE LAST FRAME
logline: A freelance filmmaker discovers a mysterious digital camera that records events from her own future, forcing her to confront a looming catastrophe and question the trustworthiness of her producer.

characters.name: FUTURE MAYA
characters.description: Maya's future self appearing in a video.

vfx_requirements: Digital camera recording light turning on mysteriously
Laptop screen displaying future video files
Apartment with overturned furniture and shattered window

scenes.heading: INT. MAYA'S APARTMENT - NIGHT
scenes.summary: Maya discovers her old digital camera recording footage from the future.

scenes.heading: ON THE LAPTOP SCREEN - VIDEO
scenes.summary: Future Maya warns Maya about the train and Daniel.

scenes.heading: INT. MAYA'S APARTMENT - LATER
scenes.summary: Daniel warns Maya to destroy the camera.

scenes.heading: INT. TRAIN STATION - NIGHT
scenes.summary: Maya confronts the future shown by the camera at the train station.
